sky cinema premiere.desc: Two brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honour their late father's final wish by scattering his ashes on a golf course. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges and comic misadventures soon turns into a week of bonding and warmth.

sky cinema premiere.title: Couples Weekend
sky cinema premiere.desc: Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.

sky cinema premiere.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
sky cinema premiere.desc: Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency. An unlikely bond forms as Molina recounts a Hollywood musical plot starring Ingrid Luna.

sky cinema premiere.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema premiere.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema premiere.title: Midwinter Break
sky cinema premiere.desc: A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

sky cinema action.title: The Scorpion King
sky cinema action.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

sky cinema action.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
sky cinema action.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

sky cinema action.title: Hummingbird
sky cinema action.desc: An alcoholic ex-soldier struggles to atone for his sins.

sky cinema action.title: First Blood
sky cinema action.desc: Brooding Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, the former Green Beret escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a cat-and-mouse chase through the mountains.

sky cinema action.title: Kong: Skull Island
sky cinema action.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after travelling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

sky cinema family.title: The Karate Kid
sky cinema family.desc: A new kid at a school makes the mistake of dating the ex-girlfriend of the school bully, whose gang then make his life a misery. He then bumps into a handyman who also happens to be a karate master. The handyman teaches him martial arts and he eventually meets up with his tormentors at a tournament, but will they fight fair?

sky cinema family.title: The Karate Kid Part II
sky cinema family.desc: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

sky cinema family.title: The Karate Kid Part III
sky cinema family.desc: A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.

sky cinema family.title: The Karate Kid
sky cinema family.desc: After moving to China, twelve-year-old Dre Parker falls in love with his classmate Mei Ying. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully, Cheng.

sky cinema comedy.title: Instant Family
sky cinema comedy.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Phoenician Scheme
sky cinema comedy.desc: Wealthy businessman, Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Intern
sky cinema comedy.desc: Ben Whittaker, a retired widower in his 70s becomes senior intern at a fashion based e-commerce company. Jules Ostin, the founder, while first hesitant, soon learns to respect and even like her new intern despite their age difference.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Naked Gun
sky cinema comedy.desc: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Opus
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A young writer travels to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by a cult of sycophants and intoxicated journalists, she soon finds herself in the middle of his twisted plan.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Evolution
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A science professor and his cohorts battle a slew of rapidly growing alien organisms that threaten to overrun the Earth.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Army of Darkness
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema thriller.title: Drop
sky cinema thriller.desc: Violet is a widowed mother who goes to a restaurant to meet Henry, her charming and handsome date. However, she soon receives phone messages from a mysterious, hooded figure who threatens to kill her young son and sister unless she kills Henry.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hallow Road
sky cinema thriller.desc: Two parents receive a distressing late-night call from their teenage daughter, who has just accidentally hit a pedestrian. They jump in their car, racing to get there before anyone else. Disturbing revelations threaten to tear the family apart.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws
sky cinema thriller.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema greats.title: Rumble in the Bronx
sky cinema greats.desc: A Hong Kong cop on holiday in New York puts his martial arts skills to good use when he helps out a friend whose shop is targeted by a vicious street gang. Martial arts hero Jackie Chan, as always, does all his own stunts.

sky cinema greats.title: Logan's Run
sky cinema greats.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

sky cinema greats.title: The Last Starfighter
sky cinema greats.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

sky cinema greats.title: Bad Boys
sky cinema greats.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

sky cinema drama.title: Widow Clicquot
sky cinema drama.desc: The story behind the Veuve Clicquot champagne family and business that began in the late 18th century.

sky cinema drama.title: Turn Me On
sky cinema drama.desc: When a couple begin to skip doses of an emotion-suppressing pill, they rediscover life in all its unfiltered glory. However, this also forces them to deal with the baggage that comes along.

sky cinema drama.title: Cat Ballou
sky cinema drama.desc: A woman seeking revenge for her murdered father hires a famous gunman, but he's very different from what she expects.

sky cinema drama.title: Black Dog
sky cinema drama.desc: Released from jail, Lang returns to his hometown in Northwest China. As part of a dog patrol tasked with clearing stray dogs before the 2008 Olympics, he bonds with a black stray. The two lonely souls embark on a new journey together.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.
